blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `restoreReservationItemsByLineItem` method. This belongs to the Inventory Next Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method is used to restore the reservation items associated with a line item or multiple line items that were deleted.

types.name: lineItemId
types.description: The ID(s) of the line item(s).

types.name: context
types.description: A context used to share re9sources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: runId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current run.

children.name: messageAggregator
children.description: An instance of a message aggregator, which is used to aggregate messages to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: requestId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current request.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.name: cancelingFromParentStep
children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

types.name: Promise
types.description: Resolves when the reservation items are successfully deleted.
